facts.value: Undergraduate degree-seeking students who previously attended ASU but have not been enrolled at ASU for up to seven consecutive fall or spring semesters.
No need to submit a new application or application fee. Must submit official transcript(s) from all institutions attended during absence.
Sign in to My ASU and register for classes. May have a hold or Priority Task to complete before registration.
To help your student pay for college, you can apply for a Parent PLUS Loan, which requires a good credit history.
If you are an active duty member or veteran of the U.S. military, your student could be eligible for tuition benefits under the Post-9/11 GI Bill®.
